Sorry, but IE8 isn't supported when using Shiny directly from R. It is, however, supported[0] when using Shiny Server, as you should be able to confirm by visiting this link: http://glimmer.rstudio.com/shiny/01_hello/


[0] with the exception of fileInput, which requires at least IE10 or any reasonably recent version of Firefox, Chrome, Safari, etc.
